insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Yone
insights.text: Yone is their first ban in 29/57 games (51%). Expect it gone before your first pick.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Yone is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Yone in 34/57 games (60%): 2 picks (0-2) and 32 bans.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Rumble? They go Renekton
insights.text: Rumble is a G1 favorite (7/24 G1s, played by Robo). In the 20 later games where it was burned or banned, Robo went to Renekton (5/20) and Aatrox (4/20).

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Teams respect-ban Varus against them
insights.text: Opponents banned Varus against them in 24/57 games (42%).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 17 G3+ games, 25/85 picks (29%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 49 champs in G1s, 56 in G3+.
